notes.title: Achievements In-bound!
notes.notes:
Episode One's Achievements are currently being tested and tested thrice more. The Store Front states that they are available RIGHT NOW, but this is a lie. A complete pork pie, if you will.

The Achievements Update will be a minor one, with a few little gameplay tweaks thrown in for good measure. Expect it to be available from the 16th of October.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 is Live!
notes.notes:
[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/326420/extras/controllerupdateart.png?t=1413286309] [/img]

[b]The Controller Update has landed![/b]

As of 14/10/2014, ahead of the official Sam Glyph Oculus Rift patch, v1.0.1 will be available! Included in this update, is support for the Windows Xbox 360 controller, as well as a few nips and tucks to Episode One and additional subtitle fixes.

notes.title: Episode One Released Today with Week-Long Discount!
notes.notes:
Sam Glyph starts his irreverent descent into the shadowy underworld of Chicago this week, with the launch of Episode One in the 'Boiled Ham' case saga.

You can nab Episode One today, which is discounted at 70% for a whole week, and which also comes bundled with the Season One Pass, which includes the free download of Epsiodes Two, Three and Four upon their release!

Don't forget, Sam has his own Twitter account too, where he can usually be found moaning about something. Follow him @samglyph to see what he's up to.

notes.title: The Official Sam Glyph Community Forum
notes.notes:
Welcome Noir lovers!

This is the OFFICIAL Sam Glyph Community Forum. Please be nice to our members (within reason) and remember: "Treat others as you wish to be treated yourself!"

Unless that 'other' stole your beloved magnifying glass or fine brandy. THEN you can shoot him in the ass. Twice.
